text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The overall scores for the championship 
tournament have been finalized. Taking the 
crown of victory was Sonnet Elfie.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a rival who fought alongside her to the 
very end, you and <chrname> send her your 
congratulations while looking back on the 
tracks she has left behind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was precisely because of her experience 
in the "U.A.F." that <chrname> grew stronger as an 
athlete and achieved great success in 
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The brilliant sparkle of competing with 
all their might alongside fellow athlete 
Umamusume will surely become an 
unforgettable memory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, hailed in both name and deed as 
the ultimate tournament, the U.A.F. came 
to a close, still wrapped in roaring 
excitement.
